HELLO.movement: Start at the forehead/temple, move outward in a small sweeping motion
HELLO.animation_plan: Right hand starts at forehead in B-shape, sweeps outward. Fast, smooth.

GO.movement: Start near body, sweep outward and forward in the direction of travel
GO.expression: Neutral or determined depending on context
GO.animation_plan: Both index fingers point forward and flick outward.

SCHOOL.animation_plan: Bring right hand down onto left palm twice. Slight pause between claps.

EAT.movement: Bring fingertips to mouth once or twice
EAT.animation_plan: Hand pinches and taps the mouth area twice.

WANT.movement: Palms up, pull hands toward body while curling fingers inward slightly
WANT.animation_plan: Hands start extended, palms up, then pull back to body curling into claws.
